oneOf.description: End when every child has ended; an untriggered child keeps it unresolved.

Document.description:
Document declarations and immutable source provenance. Revisions, compilation
caches, clocks and decoder state live outside this model.
The example is a complete editable 16:9 slide with a text shape. Coordinates
and sizes are decimal EMU strings (12700 EMU per point). Empty theme, master,
layout, font and resource maps are valid; inherited text uses the caller's
explicit delivery defaults. Copy slides/objects with distinct IDs to expand
the deck. Inspect optional feature definitions only when those features are
needed; the example requires no system font discovery or external resources.

sourceBindings.description:
Immutable native addresses/constraints. Known fields are edited in
objects; this provenance never becomes a separate mutable document.

timelines.description: Slide-owned animation graphs; empty storage preserves older author digests.

oneOf.description:
Absolute local rotation in native 1/60000 degree units, including multi-turn.
Replacement behavior; later activation wins, author order breaks ties.

Object-local scale factors in thousandths of a percent. 100000 is
identity, zero collapses an axis. Independent of the rotation channel.

Fixed property replacement while active or held. Before activation and
after removal, the underlying document/animation value is unchanged.
This does not imply the initial-hidden state of an entrance preset.

Straight native motion path, in slide fractions relative to the original
layout center. Translation is in slide axes, independent of local scale
and rotation. This is not a multi-segment/curve path approximation.

Connected lines and cubic Beziers, paced by normalized path length.
The original control points are retained for native editable export.

Native whole-object fade filter. Progress is supplied by the behavior
clock; visibility remains an independent channel, including preset helpers.

Emu.description: Signed int64 EMU. 1 point = 12700 EMU. Range requires semantic validation.

EventHistory.description:
Complete prefix, explicitly including periods when no event occurred. A host
that cannot supply this context must not invent clicks when seeking.

oneOf.description: Unlike freeze, persists when the next sequence sibling starts.

FixedQ32.description: Signed i128 integer divided by 2^32. Coordinate unit is specified by the owning geometry profile; semantic range validation required.

limit.description:
Ratio in 1/100000 units: 400000 denotes four times line width.
The ratio compares full miter length with the full stroke width.

MotionCoordinate.description: Exact decimal fraction of the slide dimension; canonicalized without rounding.

MotionPath.description:
Connected native path. Coordinates are absolute offsets from the original
layout center, measured in slide fractions. Pacing uses length in this
normalized coordinate space, before scaling the axes to slide dimensions.

MotionSegment.description:
Source control points remain editable; subdivision belongs only to the
immutable playback plan. Close returns to the initial `from` point.

transformConstraint.description: None means the complete direct transform can be changed in place.

oneOf.description: A dependency on the referenced node's interval boundary.

A lifecycle notification delivered by the referenced timing node.
This is not an event on a shape or another external event target.
Preserve the native distinction: presentation editors use onBegin to
recognize an automatic group attached to a main sequence.

transform.description:
Missing only for retained native coordinates that cannot be represented
as a complete direct declaration. Never substitute a resolved identity.

oneOf.description:
Original geometry, styles, relationships and unknown extension semantics
remain in the bound source. This is not a generic path/text promotion.

ParagraphLineSpacing.description:
Native paragraph line spacing. Percentage is measured against the line's
largest font size by the shared layout engine; 100000 means 100%, 150000 150%.

oneOf.description: Exact baseline spacing in EMU; must be representable in 1/100 point.

indent.description: Relative to the paragraph margin; negative values create a hanging indent.

lineSpacing.description: Omitted values retain native inheritance and historical document digests.

numerator.description: Positive rational pixels per EMU; normalized internally.

PlaybackGeneration.description: Canonical uint64 playback generation; never wraps.

background.description: Straight sRGB RGBA8; output is premultiplied.

origin.description: Q32 EMU. Subtracted before converting to device-space float32.

RationalTime.description: Exact wire representation. Equality compares author values; compare_time compares instants.

RepeatCount.description:
Finite values retain the existing integer wire form. Infinity is a named
alternative, never a sentinel count or a pre-expanded list of iterations.

Resource.description: Opaque authorized handle and declared content identity; byte verification belongs to the host.

RestartMode.description:
Admission of new begin instances within one parent activation. Ancestor
reactivation resets this policy, including `Never`. Omission preserves the
existing draft's once-per-parent behavior, independently of native defaults.

RotationComposition.description:
Rotation is composed before object/group placement. Layout replaces earlier
animation offsets while preserving the document's local orientation. Add
sums the sampled offset with the lower-priority visible rotation stack.

SequenceNavigation.description:
Sequence controls are document computation, independent of host buttons or
keyboard bindings. Conditions are disjunctions, like begin/end conditions.

SnapshotRecord.description: Storage envelope owned by an authorized host. A digest is not an access token.

oneOf.description:
Includes the package core title. V1 remains readable with its original
unprojected metadata semantics, so old snapshots cannot erase a title.

Includes physical table-cell text. V1/V2 keep tables opaque in their
editable document projection, while preserving their native bytes.

Projects title, description and the Office decorative accessibility
marker. Older bindings retain their original opaque accessibility view.

identityScope.description:
Immutable origin namespace used to derive source-local IDs. Absence
retains the original document-ID-derived representation. A whole-deck
instance pins this namespace before changing its document identity.
This is provenance for calculation, never host access authority.

StartCondition.description:
A flat disjunction of native begin conditions. The single-condition wire
representation remains unchanged; alternatives cannot recursively nest.

cap.description: Absent retains an unresolved declaration, not an implicit flat cap.

id.description:
Row/column/cell identities are table-scoped. Text identities remain
document-scoped so existing anchors retain their unambiguous meaning.

oneOf.description: The origin is the upper-left cell. Counts include the origin.

cells.description: One entry per grid column, even when covered by another cell.

Ticks.description: Signed int64 ticks. Range requires semantic validation.

oneOf.description: An explicitly indefinite condition, never a fabricated zero-time event.

TimeTransform.description:
Local behavior clock. Percentages use native thousandths of one percent;
100000 speed is normal playback. The clock is independent of effect values.

Timeline.description:
Behaviors plus an optional explicit timing forest. The legacy graph retains
its byte representation; version 0.2 owns every behavior through tree roots.

presentation.description:
Native presentation identity. It participates in initial playback state
and editable export; it never changes the container's declared clock.

timeTransform.description:
Filter the container's simple time before its descendants consume it.
Compilation validates the supported clock domain; this is never copied
into the leaves or interpreted as an independent per-effect easing.

endConditions.description: Earliest resolved eligible end; absent conditions add no end constraint.

repeatDuration.description: Additional bound in local active time, before speed scaling.

repeatMilli.description: Native count in thousandths, or explicit indefinite repetition.

rotation.description: Units of 1/60000 degree. Author direction is preserved.
